original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-quasi-coherent-and-flat-base-change}
Let $S$ be a scheme. Let $\tau \in \{Zar, \etale\}$.
Let $\mathcal{G}$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal{O}$-modules on
$(\Sch/S)_{fppf}$ such that
\begin{enumerate}
\item $\mathcal{G}|_{S_\tau}$ is quasi-coherent, and
\item for every flat, locally finitely presented morphism
$g : U \to S$ the canonical map
$g_{\tau, small}^*(\mathcal{G}|_{S_\tau}) \to \mathcal{G}|_{U_\tau}$
is an isomorphism.
\end{enumerate}
Then $H^p(U, \mathcal{G}) = H^p(U, \mathcal{G}|_{U_\tau})$
for every $U$ flat and locally of finite presentation over $S$.

final_content.statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme, $\tau\in\{\mathrm{Zariski},\mathrm{\acute etale}\}$, and $\mathcal G$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules on the big fppf site $(\operatorname{Sch}/S)_{\mathrm{fppf}}$. Assume (1) its restriction to the small $\tau$ ringed site $S_\tau$ is quasi-coherent; and (2) for every flat locally finitely presented morphism $g:U\to S$, the canonical comparison map from the small-site pullback $g_{\tau,\mathrm{small}}^*(\mathcal G|_{S_\tau})$ to $\mathcal G|_{U_\tau}$ is an isomorphism. Then for every such $U$ and every $p\geq0$ the natural comparison map from fppf cohomology of $\mathcal G$ over $U$ to cohomology of its restriction on the small site $U_\tau$ is an isomorphism:
$$H^p((\operatorname{Sch}/U)_{\mathrm{fppf}},\mathcal G|_U)\cong H^p(U_\tau,\mathcal G|_{U_\tau}).$$
hypotheses: G big-fppf module; small-site restriction is QCoh and is compatible with small-site pullbacks along all flat locally finitely presented U→S.
conclusions: Big fppf and small tau cohomology agree on these U.
